about: Hand-checked inputs for the human cost of each wait. For each drug: the median survival with and without it in a randomised trial, and the number of people in the US who become eligible each year, each with a source and a quote. The build multiplies these by the wait. A drug is left out when its trial reached no median, when the survival gain was not statistically significant, or when no sourced patient count could be found.

left_out.loqtorzi: Median survival was not reached in the drug group, so there is no gain in months to multiply.
left_out.lazcluze: Median survival was not reached in the drug group, so there is no gain in months to multiply.
left_out.sarclisa: The survival difference (24.6 vs 17.7 months) was not statistically significant.
left_out.tevimbra: No sourced US patient count; the best estimate rests on an unsourced assumption and probably runs high.
left_out.itovebi: No sourced US patient count; the best estimate is order-of-magnitude only.

os_source.quote: the median overall survival was 21.9 months and 17.4 months, respectively.

tukysa.eligible_basis: This is the number of US patients with third-line HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer, from a competitor's annual report. Tukysa's label starts one line of treatment earlier, so the true number is probably higher.

eligible_sources.quote: We also believe that there are approximately 6,400 patients in the United States with third-line and 4,700 patients in the United States with fourth line HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer.

trodelvy.eligible_basis: A rough estimate that probably runs low: 42,170 US breast cancer deaths a year, taken as the number of new metastatic cases, times the 15% that are triple-negative, times the 26% of treated patients who reach a third line of treatment.

eligible_sources.quote: with over 276,000 new cases and estimated 42,170 deaths in the United States in 2020
Among 2004 patients who received 1L treatment, 51% ( n = 1030) and 26% ( n = 524) subsequently received a 2L and 3L treatment, respectively

trodelvy.note: The first approval rested on a smaller trial without a comparison group. The survival figures come from the randomised trial that confirmed it a year later.

qinlock.eligible_basis: This is the midpoint of the manufacturer's estimate of 1,000 to 1,300 new fourth-line patients a year, from US insurance claims.

eligible_sources.quote: we estimate that the annual new treatment-eligible population of fourth-line GIST patients in the U.S. is approximately 1,000 to 1,300.

qinlock.note: The trial's rules did not allow a formal significance test on survival. Two thirds of the patients on placebo switched to the drug when their cancer grew, which narrows the measured gap.

os_source.quote: Median overall survival was 7·4 months (95% CI 6·7-8·2) in the fruquintinib group versus 4·8 months (4·0-5·8) in the placebo group

fruzaqla.eligible_basis: This is the manufacturer's estimate of US patients with metastatic colorectal cancer in their third or later line of treatment.

eligible_sources.quote: Takeda estimated 14,600 3L & 4L+ metastatic CRC patients in the U.S.

os_source.quote: median overall survival was 31·9 months (95% CI 21·0-not estimable) for quizartinib versus 15·1 months (13·2-26·2) for placebo

vanflyta.eligible_basis: Worked out from 20,380 new US cases of acute myeloid leukemia a year, times the 25% with the FLT3-ITD mutation, times the 56% who receive the intensive chemotherapy the drug is given with.

eligible_sources.quote: an estimated 20,380 new cases will be diagnosed in the U.S. in 2023.
FLT3-ITD mutations occur in about 25% of all AML cases, with frequency reported as high as 30%.
Patients received a multiagent (74.9%, n = 34 576), single-agent (21.8%, n = 10 086), or unspecified (3.3%, n = 1505) chemotherapy regimen.

vyloy.eligible_basis: Worked out from 26,890 new US stomach and gastroesophageal junction cancers a year, times the 35% already spread at diagnosis, times the 80% that are HER2-negative, times the 38% that carry the claudin 18.2 marker.

eligible_sources.quote: In 2024, it is estimated that 26,890 people will be diagnosed with G/GEJ cancer and 10,880 will die from the disease in the U.S.
Approximately 35% of patients diagnosed with GC are found to have metastatic disease.

vyloy.note: A second trial, GLOW, found a similar gain: 14.4 months against 12.2.

os_source.quote: Treatment with tarlatamab resulted in significantly longer overall survival than chemotherapy (median, 13.6 months [95% confidence interval {CI}, 11.1 to not reached] vs. 8.3 months [95% CI, 7.0 to 10.2]

imdelltra.eligible_basis: Worked out from 234,580 new US lung cancers a year, times the 14% that are small cell, times the 70% found at the extensive stage, times the 38.6% of those patients who go on to a second line of treatment.

eligible_sources.quote: In 2024, an estimated 234,580 new cases of lung cancer will be diagnosed in the US
992 (38.6%), 344 (13.4%), and 114 (4.4%) received ≥ 1, ≥ 2, and ≥ 3 subsequent treatment lines, respectively.

imdelltra.note: The first approval rested on a smaller trial without a comparison group. The survival figures come from the randomised trial that confirmed it in 2025.

pluvicto.eligible_basis: This is the number of US patients who actually started or completed the treatment in 2024, so it is a floor. The manufacturer sizes the wider group it was tested in at 27,000 new patients a year.

eligible_sources.quote: Approximately 11,000 patients started or completed Pluvicto treatment in 2024.
2L+ US: 27k

kimmtrak.eligible_basis: Worked out from 5.1 cases of uveal melanoma per million people a year across 333 million people, times the 50% whose cancer spreads, times the 45% who carry the HLA-A*02:01 marker the drug needs.

eligible_sources.quote: The mean age-adjusted incidence of uveal melanoma in the United States was 5.1 per million (95% CI, 4.8-5.3).
The presence of human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-A*02:01 is seen in approximately 45% of individuals with uveal melanoma in the United States and Europe

imjudo.eligible_basis: Worked out from 36,000 new US liver cancers a year, times the 75% that are hepatocellular carcinoma, times the 15% of those patients who receive drug treatment within a year. Counting everyone diagnosed at an advanced stage instead would give about 13,500.

eligible_sources.quote: approximately 36,000 new diagnoses each year. ... About 75% of all primary liver cancers in adults are HCC.
the use of systemic therapy slightly decreased (2014-2017, 17.0%; 2018-2019, 15.2%; p = .01).

imjudo.note: The comparison was against sorafenib, an existing drug, not against no treatment.

elahere.eligible_basis: This is the manufacturer's estimate of US patients covered by the first approval.

eligible_sources.quote: ImmunoGen said this allows the treatment to be available to about 5,200 patients in the US.
There are 19,500 drug - treatable 2L - 4L platinum - resistant ovarian cancer patients in the U.S. each year (DRG).

elahere.note: The first approval rested on a smaller trial without a comparison group. The survival figures come from the randomised trial that confirmed it in 2024.

tivdak.eligible_basis: A rough estimate: 4,280 US deaths from cervical cancer a year, taken as the number of women starting treatment for cancer that has returned or spread, times the 51% who go on to a second treatment.

eligible_sources.quote: SEER estimated that 14,100 women would be diagnosed with cervical cancer in the United States in 2022, and that 4,280 would die from cervical cancer.
During follow-up, over half (51.0 %) of the 1L-treated r/mCC patients received 2L treatment.

tivdak.note: The first approval rested on a smaller trial without a comparison group. The survival figures come from the randomised trial that confirmed it in 2024.
